## @aegis-skills/themis-core 0.1.0 - first release

The deterministic engine of Themis (policy, redaction, risk scoring, approvals, audit log, local store). It makes no model calls and no network requests.

This is an **internal library, pre-1.0**. Its API is not a public contract and can change in any 0.x release, and Themis itself is still in development and not released. You normally do not need to install it. Pin an exact version if you do.

Install: `npm install @aegis-skills/themis-core` (Node.js 24 or later). Licence: Apache-2.0 OR MIT.

This release is not marked Latest on GitHub: the Latest release is reserved for `aegis-skills`, because Gemini CLI reads its extension archives from it.
